title: Bolus delivery error while being delivered. Not recorded in NS.
symptom: During bolus delivery via the wizard, a bolus delivery error appears on AAPS, but the bolus is actually delivered when manually checking the pump. The bolus is not recorded in Nightscout unless the user clicks 'Refresh' in the Medtronic Menu to get recent pump history. Carbs also are not recorded in Nightscout and must be manually added in AAPS.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause. One user speculates that the pump might have been busy with something else, perhaps SMB, but this is not confirmed.
fix: No definitive fix is stated. The issue reports that after the next history reading, the bolus is shown in Nightscout, but carbs are not because AAPS did not make entries in that case. The user eventually changed pumps.
evidence_quote: After next history reading the bolus was shown in NS, but not the carbs. Thats normal, because AAPS didn't make entrys in that case.
